integrity: Three self-contained source programs and their execution outputs are included. Explicit incidence and LCF models are shown isomorphic. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Theorem applies to one specified eighteen-vertex cubic incidence graph. Exchange metrics refer to the unique nontrivial component of two disconnected reconfiguration graphs. Computer-assisted exhaustive finite certification is supplied; no infinite-family result or external priority certification is claimed. Full text of a relevant 2014 matching/semitotal paper was unavailable.
title: Nine frozen total codes and a mobile semitotal-domination sector of the Pappus graph
